description: This Java class 'RetrieveThingStrategy' implements a strategy for handling 'RetrieveThing' commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework, specifically for retrieving and processing 'Thing' entities, including generating responses, headers, and managing entity tags.

classes.name: RetrieveThingStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends 'AbstractThingCommandStrategy' to handle 'RetrieveThing' commands, managing retrieval logic, response creation, headers, entity tags, and error handling.

methods.name: RetrieveThingStrategy
methods.description: Constructor for the class, initializing with 'RetrieveThing' class type.

methods.name: isDefined
methods.description: Checks if the command applies to the given context and 'Thing', verifying that the entity IDs match and the thing is not deleted.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the retrieval logic, creating a result with the 'Thing' data and appropriate headers or metadata.

methods.name: getRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a response object for the 'RetrieveThing' command if the 'Thing' exists, otherwise prepares a not accessible error.

methods.name: getThingJson
methods.description: Serializes the 'Thing' object into JSON, considering selected fields and schema version.

methods.name: notAccessible
methods.description: Constructs a 'ThingNotAccessibleException' for the given command.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Provides an error result if the command cannot be handled because the 'Thing' is not accessible.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Retrieves the previous entity tag if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates the next entity tag from the new 'Thing' entity, if available.
